summary: Frontend-only verification of two new Task Manager features: Task Comments (notes/blockers with author-delete + persistent count badge) and Weekly Heat-strip (7-day cells with due/overdue counts, urgent flame, active-ring, day-click to change date, scope-aware header). All requested behaviors pass. Regression checks (urgent pill, added-date, checklist rows, date bar prev/next/today, delete) also pass.
critical_code_review_comments: TodoComments.jsx data-testids for kind toggle, input and send button include the todo id suffix (comment-kind-note-<id>, comment-input-<id>, comment-send-<id>) whereas the review request lists the shorter forms (comment-kind-note, comment-input, comment-send). Both point to the same elements; only nomenclature. Consider aligning docs or adding aliased attrs to keep the review contract exact.

load() inside TodoComments always triggers onCountChange with the fetched length; this is called on every open which causes an extra network round-trip and a re-render of the parent list on each expansion. Acceptable but could be memoised.
delete confirmation for comments is silent (no window.confirm); an accidental click permanently deletes. Consider a confirm or an undo toast.
